description: FREE. Expands one step of an emit_app recipe: the full instruction, why it matters, how to know it worked, and what to do when it did not. emit_app returns steps in short form to stay inside the response budget, so this carries the detail for any step that needs it. Needs the same share code and the step's id.

appId.description: the share code you passed to emit_app

name: get_step
title: Expand a recipe step
